notes.title: Saen'Liz redesign reveal + Devlog #121
notes.content:
New devlog!

I revealed a redesign of Saen'Liz, the necromancer! She was drawn by Bulumblebee ^^
I've been working on even more art stuff, including, finally, some chibi BE sprites reveals!
On top of that, I finished my cup size research. Good stuff ^^

edit 01:

Mini update to the demo!


 Fixed a rare crash
 Fixed the infinite SFX loop when failing to use Veomea as Vestia during the Angel fight
 Added a party event to introduce save rooms and saving
 Added a sign in Auria tower to explain map icons

notes.title: QoL fix
notes.content:
First of all, thank you to everyone who's been playing BE Witches! ^^

A new QoL update has been uploaded! It's available right now, you should be able to just download it and keep playing from where you left off.
Lunlun (Tiger girl) got a new sprite by Bulumblebee! She's now available in game ^^

More to see on Bluesky/Twitter!
https://bsky.app/profile/nosebecc.bsky.social
https://x.com/nosebecc

Changelog:


 Lunlun (Tiger girl)'s default sprite has been updated
 Notes can be closed by pressing Enter
 Slightly lowerzs Nightmare and Myasine's summon speed
 Slightly increased cast time for Myasine's Sporinid spell
 Edited a few chest's content in Sablee / Sablee ocean
 Auria hidden walls make a noise > Fixed
 Fish puzzle door leads up instead of down > Fixed
 Made alma flash and play an SFX at the same time as a page if one is in the same room (only important tuto page)
 Slightly improved the Gear puzzle explanation
 Improved various tuto pages
 The hint button now plays an SFX when it appears
 Added more text for Heart carrots
 Added a next task button in the exploration UI
 Shell count puzzle buttons now reset and play a better SFX after failing (no need to leave and come back)
 Fei portals now give an item warning if necessary
 Simplified Fei petal puzzles by improving petal and pellet placement to make them more intuitive
 Added a sign in Eveii's alchemy room mentioning alchemy is unavailable until she comes back
 Added a sign to explain save rooms
 Added signs to warn of the pit
 Added a sign explaining character select in the Biscotti save room
 Added a party event during festival which triggers if the player didn't play every minigame
 Giraffe shapes now have a visual warning and a small delay before they show up from the bottom of the screen
 Slightly updated the hint text for the shell count puzzle and the fish puzzle
 Reduced the exploration area before finding Eveii (it turns out the reason it comprised so much of Sablee was to give access to the save room from the get go, but there isn't much of a point to it that early)



2025 02 05 edit:

A few more bug fixes and improvements!


 Fixed a bug that could occur when oyons being moved turn into mushrooms (Oyons can't turn into mushroom anymore while selected)
 Slightly nerfed Myasine's Sporinid's Shape spawn
 Moved the "?" button page sign closer to the start
 Constellations hint event improved
 Star shooter hint event added
 Added "(no boob...)" text next to the Rank lock setting



2025 02 07 edit:

One more fix!


 Added information on the SMASH page about destroying fights



2025 02 16 edit:

Some more fixes!


 Fixed a bug that would get the player stuck in the lower part of Sablee in some rare cases in the post game.
 Added text to mention how a spell's color determine which Fei is required to cast it in an ocean info sign
 Improved version check
